message: Thanks for posting this, Mike. I like that you're giving our book some love, of course, but I'm also interested in the pieces you're putting together because my talk at the CCCCs this year is going to be about the evolutions (or de-volutions, I suppose) of the business plan of MOOC providers. Cheekily, my talk is going to be called "Risky Business." We'll see how it comes together.
